what: Why the smoothing spline loses the held-out endpoint to the raw-centroid chord (REPORT 4.3): aim points, edit rules, smoothing, norm, knot order and readers, on the headline arc (seed 0) and the 16 contiguous 45-degree arcs (seeds 1-16).

conventions.gap: arm minus add:chord_raw, paired per clip, averaged over the 384 steered (clip, target) pairs of an arc; + = arm worse on probe/mlp error; for R + = arm better
conventions.add: x + lift(P(target) - P(source)), residual kept (our main arms)
conventions.replace: PCA-64 part of x replaced by P(target), residual kept (Goodfire A.6 manifold rule)
conventions.replace_full: whole activation replaced by the full-space raw-centroid chord point (Goodfire A.6 linear rule)
conventions.add_norm:A@B: arm A's additive edit rescaled per clip to arm B's norm
conventions.hybrid: target point from one rule, source anchor from another
conventions.oracle: true held-out centroid from the knot-fold clips at the held-out value (excluded from every fit); raw centroid at kept values
conventions.causalab_*: refs/causalab SplineManifold/CubicSpline1D (periodic, period 2 pi given explicitly) run on our knots and coordinates; lam = Reinsch smoothness; lam_cv = chosen by leave-8-knot-block-out on kept knots only
conventions.splrep_s<f>: our SmoothSpline with s = f * m (f = 1 is the stored arm)
conventions.readers: probe = ridge on probe folds (the REPORT's endpoint reader); mlp = one-hidden-layer MLP on probe folds (seed 0); R = nearest-real agreement against test clips at the target
conventions.bulge_beta: <mu - chord, spline - chord>/|spline - chord|^2 at each held-out target, averaged over the 8 targets: 1 = true centroid where the spline puts it, 0 = on the raw chord

exploratory_note: Every variant here was scored on the test read. The Reinsch lambda was chosen per arc by a knot-only leave-block-out CV (no test, probe or held-out clip), written after the lambda sweep on the seed-0 headline arc had been seen; the 16 arcs were first scored after the rule was fixed. Treat the lam_cv result as exploratory.

verdict.implementation_error_ours: Yes. The stored spline is FITPACK splrep per coordinate (weights sqrt(count)/sd_c, s = m, adaptive knot subset), neither the paper's interpolating spline (A.3) nor causalab's Reinsch smoother. It degrades direction at the knots and in the gap, and the additive edit anchored at the source's smoothed knot counts that error twice. Replacing it with causalab's code (lambda = 0) cuts the point-22 16-arc gap from +2.33 to +0.84 and the headline from +7.05 to -0.48.
verdict.paper_protocol: Interpolating periodic cubic (causalab, lambda 0) through raw centroids: the spline still loses the 16-arc mean on the probe (+0.84 pt 22, +1.56 pt 12 labels; +27 on the paper's label-free knot order at pt 12) and loses nearest-real R on every arc (-0.21 / -0.14), because across a 45 degree gap it overshoots 12 / 7.5 PCA units from the true held-out centroids (chord 5.0 / 3.3). With the A.6 replace rule: 4.83 vs 3.86 (pt 22).
verdict.corrected_smoother_exploratory: causalab Reinsch smoothing, lambda by knot-only CV (1e-5 to 1e-4): the spline wins the endpoint on every arc at point 22 (-0.45 +- 0.21 deg, 16/16; MLP -1.48, 14/16; R +0.025, 16/16) and point 12 on value-ordered knots (-0.85 +- 0.34, 16/16; MLP 16/16; R 16/16); on the stored label-free point-12 order it is -0.44 +- 1.36 (8/16). The true held-out centroids sit 0.78 / 0.90 of the way from the raw chord to this curve, but that separation (2.0 / 1.4 PCA units) is below the true centroid's own noise (3.9 / 2.6), so the gain is under 1 degree and about half of it is denoised anchors rather than bend.
verdict.reader: The negative is probe-specific. The ridge probe is affine, so it reads a chord point as the interpolation of its two endpoint readings: raw-chord aim points read 1.53 deg off at pt 22 vs 2.89 for the true held-out centroid. Under the stored smoothing spline the MLP already favours the spline at pt 22 (-0.66, 10/16) and nearest-real R does on 16/16.
verdict.norm: Not the mechanism. The spline's endpoint edit is shorter than the chord's (11.39 vs 11.85 at pt 22), and the chord rescaled to the spline's norm still wins by +2.40 (16-arc) at pt 22. At the pt 22 headline, norm accounts for 2.7 of the 7.05 deg.
